 Order

Present application has been filed for cancellation of bail granted to respondent No. 2 / accused
Ganesh Kumar Ojha vide order dated 12.7.2023 passed in Mcrc No.26734/2023.
As per prosecution story, r

espondent No. 2 / accused along with other co-accused persons cheated the present petitioner / complainant as well as other persons and got the sale deeds and agreements to sale executed in respect to lands which did not belong to the seller / persons said to be selling the lands.
Upon this FIR bearing Crime No.126/2023 was registered against respondent No. 2 and other accused persons for offence under Sections 420, 406, 409 and 34 of IPC and during investigation,
respondent No. 2 / accused was arrested.
Thereafter, bail application was filed before this Court which was allowed vide order dated 12.7.2023.

Learned counsel for the petitioner / complainant argued that the bail NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-GWL:19589 2 MCRC-42648-2023 was obtained by respondent No. 2 / accused by presenting wrong facts that he is not the partner of Char-Chatur Associates and he is the permanent resident of District - Gwalior, however, as per Aadhar Card of respondent No. 2 / accused (Annexure - C), he is the permanent resident of Jaipur (Rajasthan).

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the State also supported the version of learned counsel for the petitioner and argued that as per the direction of this Court, verification report by Police Station - Padav, District - Gwalior No.817/2024 dated 17.3.2024 has been received according to which, respondent No. 2 /
accused Ganesh Kumar Ojha is the permanent resident of Jaipur (Rajasthan) and not District - Gwalior (M.P.).
The e-stamp verification certificate as well as the agreement executed on stamp between Ganesh Ojha and Rekha Rani prove that he is the partner of Char Chatur Associates.

Kirayanama (rent- agreement) executed with Vinay, which has also been verified, indicates that respondent No. 2 / accused Ganesh Ojha is the Director of Char Chatur Group of Developers,
Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh.
In view of above facts, the bail granted to respondent No. 2 / accused Ganesh Ojha deserves to be recalled.

On the other hand, learned counsel for respondent No. 2 / accused opposed the submissions made by learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned counsel for the State and prayed to dismiss the application.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant and perused the available NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-GWL:19589 3 MCRC-42648-2023 record.
The bail order dated 12.7.2023 passed in MCRC No. 26734/2023 indicates that the main argument of respondent No. 2 / accused was that he has falsely been implicated in this case and he is not the partner of Char Chatur Associates and is the permanent resident of District - Gwalior

, however, as per the documents filed by the complainant as well as verification report of the said documents, he is the partner / director of Char Chatur Associates and is the permanent resident of Jaipur (Rajasthan) and not Gole ka Mandir, District - Gwalior (M.P.) which are suppression of material facts and presentation of wrong facts.

In view of above, present application is allowed and order dated 12.7.2023 passed in MCRC No.26734/2023 granting bail to respondent No.2 / accused - Ganesh Kumar Ojha relating to Crime No.126/2023 registered at Police Station - Padav, District - Gwalior (M.P.) is hereby recalled.
Respondent No. 2 / accused - Ganesh Kumar Ojha is directed to surrender before the trial Court within 15 days from today failing which trial Court shall issue warrant of arrest against him.

(SUNITA YADAV) JUDGE AKS Smt. Vimla Lodhi(Wrongly Mentioned In ... vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67151096/
